Docs/Common issues

Common issues

Check the contract and process state before changing an evaluation configuration.

Installation and assets

Environment ID is not registered

Run from the project checkout and import the task module before direct Gym creation. Check the canonical registry for the exact ID; aliases and retired curricula are not formal benchmark targets.

Missing meshes or scene assets

Confirm that the project’s robot, object and native-room assets are present. The website has no public source/dataset mirror yet; screenshots and the paper PDF are not a simulator installation package.

GPU or renderer startup fails

Check the local SAPIEN/ManiSkill environment and driver support independently of the policy. The native-scene contract specifies CPU physics; rendering still requires a working renderer.

Evaluation and collection

Action or state dimension mismatch

Query the environment space. Sharpa single-arm and dual-arm layouts differ; task observation widths vary. Verify joint order, image keys, normalization and relative-to-absolute arm conversion.

Factory rejects an override

Use the registered horizon, robot, 256 × 256 policy camera profile, pd_joint_pos and one CPU environment. Avoid overriding these solely to bypass validation.

Replay or native-scene validation fails

Compare the task/source fingerprint, reset seed, background manifest and object placement. Restoring rigid state does not restore the solver’s transient contact cache; contact-dependent quantities are excluded from frame-restoration equality checks.

SDK: Address already in use

ss -ltnp '( sport = :2044 or sport = :6668 )'

Check whether a previous Sharpa SDK bridge still owns either port, then reuse it or shut down its owning terminal cleanly. For another hand, inspect that hand’s configured ports.
